# Rofik Godi Centre — Complete Store, Catalog, Vehicle & Policy Knowledge Base

> Authoritative machine-readable reference for Rofik Godi Centre (`https://rofik-godi.pages.dev`), a custom bike, scooter, and Toto (E-Rickshaw) seat cover manufacturer and ride-essentials workshop in Berhampore, Murshidabad, West Bengal, India.

---

## 1. Business Identity, Location & Contact

- **Official Store Name**: Rofik Godi Centre (`ROFIK GODI CENTRE`)
- **Tagline**: Local Ride Essentials & Seat Manufacturing — Comfort for Every Ride

- **Full Address**: Kadbeltal, Petrol Pump More, Raninagar, Keshobnagar, Berhampore, West Bengal 742101, India

## 2. Public Website Routes vs. Private Routes

### Indexable Public Pages
- `https://rofik-godi.pages.dev/` and `/home` — Main storefront showcasing hero offers, categories, vehicle finder, bestsellers, and customer reviews
- `https://rofik-godi.pages.dev/shop` — Full filterable catalog across Bike Covers, Toto Covers, Cushions, and Custom Accessories
- `https://rofik-godi.pages.dev/shop/products/<product-id>` — Individual product detail pages with live INR pricing, color selector, thickness upgrades, stitch options, and vehicle compatibility
- `https://rofik-godi.pages.dev/custom` — Interactive Custom Seat Cover Builder (choose vehicle type, material, stitch pattern, color, foam thickness, and personalized embroidery)
- `https://rofik-godi.pages.dev/search` — Instant catalog and voice search across seat covers, materials, and vehicle models
- `https://rofik-godi.pages.dev/store-map` — Workshop storefront details, opening hours, contact numbers, and interactive location card
- `https://rofik-godi.pages.dev/store-map/navigation` — Embedded live map and turn-by-turn navigation to Kadbeltal, Petrol Pump More
- `https://rofik-godi.pages.dev/settings/about` — About Rofik Godi Centre workshop heritage and services
- `https://rofik-godi.pages.dev/terms-and-conditions` — Store pickup rules, payment methods, cancellations, returns, and guarantee exclusions
- `https://rofik-godi.pages.dev/privacy-policy` — Customer data protection, payment security, notification preferences, and account privacy
- `https://rofik-godi.pages.dev/personal-data` — Personal data usage and 7-day scheduled account deletion policy

### Private / Authenticated Routes (Disallowed for Indexing)
`/admin/*`, `/account`, `/profile`, `/my-orders/*`, `/my-order/*`, `/myorder/*`, `/cart`, `/checkout`, `/wishlist`, `/notifications`, `/support/*`, `/contact-support`, `/coupons/*`, `/signup/*`, `/onboarding`, `/auth/*`.

## 5. Store Pickup, Payments, Guarantee & 7-Point Workshop Policy

### Workshop Services
- Free on-spot seat fitment at our Berhampore workshop with every store pickup
- Custom foam modification and tailbone pressure cutout
- Personalized computerized machine embroidery & name stitching (up to 12 characters on eligible custom covers)
- Same-day store pickup and quality check before handover

### Fulfillment & Payments
- **Pickup Only (No Online Courier Delivery)**: All website/app orders are prepared for in-person collection at Rofik Godi Centre, Kadbeltal, Petrol Pump More, Berhampore. Customers show their Order Number and in-app Pickup QR / Pickup Code at the counter. Ready orders are held for up to 14 days.
- **Payment Options**: Pay Online via Razorpay Checkout (UPI, Debit/Credit Cards, Netbanking, Wallets) or Pay at Workshop on Pickup.
- **Cancellations & Refunds**: Uncustomized orders can be cancelled prior to workshop preparation; custom-embroidered or cut-to-order seats cannot be cancelled once stitching starts. Approved online refunds are credited back to the original source within 3–5 working banking days.
- **7-Day Workshop Defect Check**: Unused, uninstalled standard covers qualify for workshop replacement within 7 days of pickup for verified stitching flaws or sizing mismatches.

### Official Product Replacement Guarantee
- Products assigned a guarantee expiry date by Rofik Godi Centre on the official invoice are covered under normal everyday use for natural splitting/cracking, seam tearing, or rexine/leatherette surface peeling.
- Strictly excluded: physical damage from accidents, cat or animal scratches, blade/knife cuts, fire or burn damage, chemical exposure, or intentional misuse.

### 7-Point Workshop Terms & Guarantee Policy (On Official Invoices)
1. **Product Inspection**: Customers are requested to check the seat cover and fitting before leaving the workshop.
2. **Fitting Guarantee**: Any fitting-related issue caused by our workmanship will be inspected and corrected within a reasonable time.
3. **Manufacturing Defects**: Genuine manufacturing defects will be inspected and handled according to the applicable product warranty.
4. **No Guarantee on Physical Damage**: Damage caused by accidents, cuts, burns, improper handling, or external factors is not covered.
5. **Customer Responsibility**: Customers must ensure that the selected product and fitting meet their requirements before confirming the purchase.
6. **Invoice Required**: Original invoice must be presented for any warranty or service-related claim.
7. **Final Inspection**: Once the product and fitting are checked and accepted by the customer, subsequent claims will be subject to inspection.
